Keep kubectl and the k3s image in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic mise group so it wins for kubectl.
prBodyNotes: :warning: `k8s/cluster/k3d.yaml` is shared verbatim with every repo using the `dynamist-dev` cluster. Bump it in all of them in the same window, or the `coexistence` job fails on the diff. Recreate the cluster with `make destroy` + `make up` afterwards.
